mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (title, writer, content) VALUES (#{title}, #{writer}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET title = #{title}, writer = #{writer}, content = #{content}, upd_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE post_no = #{postNo}
mapper.select: SELECT post_no, title, writer, content, reg_date, upd_date FROM post ORDER BY post_no DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
